create_SimpleCamera: create a SimpleCamera instance with R, T, and K intrinsic/extrinsic camera parameters
create_SimpleCameraTorch: create a SimpleCameraTorch instance with R, T, K parameters on a given torch device
world_to_camera_SimpleCamera: project 3D world coordinates to camera coordinates using SimpleCamera world_to_camera method
camera_to_pixel_SimpleCamera: project 3D camera coordinates to 2D pixel coordinates using SimpleCamera camera_to_pixel method
world_to_pixel_SimpleCamera: project 3D world coordinates directly to 2D pixel coordinates using SimpleCamera world_to_pixel method
